description: Summary of the portal's 3D bed model of a reservoir, lake or river section: maximum and mean depth, water volume, surface area, water level, where the depth comes from (pre-flooding maps, literature, angling rules or an estimate), sources and notes. It is a model, not a survey: not for navigation or diving.

water_id.description: Page id of the water (from search_site or waters_near).

name: get_bed_model
title: Bed model of a reservoir or river
